<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_ui_action"><sys_ui_action action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><action_name/><active>true</active><client>false</client><client_script_v2><![CDATA[function onClick(g_form) {

]]></client_script_v2><comments/><condition/><form_action>false</form_action><form_button>false</form_button><form_button_icon/><form_button_v2>false</form_button_v2><form_context_menu>false</form_context_menu><form_link>false</form_link><form_menu_button_v2>false</form_menu_button_v2><form_style/><format_for_configurable_workspace>false</format_for_configurable_workspace><hint/><isolate_script>false</isolate_script><list_action>false</list_action><list_banner_button>false</list_banner_button><list_button>false</list_button><list_button_icon/><list_choice>false</list_choice><list_context_menu>false</list_context_menu><list_link>false</list_link><list_save_with_form_button>false</list_save_with_form_button><list_style/><messages/><name>Export Matching Workloads</name><onclick/><order>100</order><script><![CDATA[(function executeExportMatchingWorkloads(current, action, gs) {
    var configSysId = current.getUniqueValue();
    var tableName = current.getTableName();
    var redirectUrl = tableName + '.do?sys_id=' + configSysId;

    if (gs.nil(configSysId)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage("Unable to determine PCE Configuration.");
        action.setRedirectURL(redirectUrl);
        return;
    }

    try {
        var utils = new IllumioUtils();
        var syncFilterResult = utils.getEligibleWorkloadSysIdsByConfig(configSysId, 'inclusion');

        if (!syncFilterResult.hasFilter) {
            gs.addInfoMessage("No active inclusion sync filters configured for this PCE Configuration.");
            action.setRedirectURL(redirectUrl);
            return;
        }

        var sysIds = syncFilterResult.sysIds;

        if (!sysIds || sysIds.length === 0) {
            gs.addInfoMessage("No workloads match the active inclusion sync filter criteria.");
            action.setRedirectURL(redirectUrl);
            return;
        }

        var csvContent = utils.generateWorkloadCsv(sysIds);

        var configName = current.getValue('name') || 'pce_config';
        var timestamp = new GlideDateTime().getDisplayValue().replace(/[:\s]/g, '_');
        var fileName = 'matching_workloads_' + configName + '_' + timestamp + '.csv';

        var sa = new GlideSysAttachment();
        var attachmentSysId = sa.write(tableName, configSysId, fileName, 'text/csv', csvContent);

        if (gs.nil(attachmentSysId)) {
            gs.error('[ExportMatchingWorkloads] GlideSysAttachment.write returned nil. Table: ' + tableName + ', SysId: ' + configSysId + ', FileName: ' + fileName + ', CSV length: ' + csvContent.length);
            gs.addErrorMessage("Failed to generate CSV export. Check application logs for details.");
        } else {
            gs.addInfoMessage(sysIds.length + " matching workloads exported. Download the CSV from the attachments on this record.");
        }
    } catch (ex) {
        gs.error('[ExportMatchingWorkloads] Exception: ' + ex);
        gs.addErrorMessage("Error exporting workloads: " + ex);
    }

    action.setRedirectURL(redirectUrl);
})(current, action, gs);
]]></script><show_form_icon_only>false</show_form_icon_only><show_insert>true</show_insert><show_list_icon_only>false</show_list_icon_only><show_multiple_update>false</show_multiple_update><show_query>false</show_query><show_update>true</show_update><sys_class_name>sys_ui_action</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-27 05:54:00</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>ffd0174ec31a031050bffa0ed40131a6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Export Matching Workloads</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Illumio" source="x_illu2_illumio">15314f1ddb882700dc9fabc5ca961943</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Illumio">15314f1ddb882700dc9fabc5ca961943</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_action_ffd0174ec31a031050bffa0ed40131a6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-27 05:54:00</sys_updated_on><table/><ui11_compatible>true</ui11_compatible><ui16_compatible>false</ui16_compatible></sys_ui_action></record_update>
